```gherkin
Feature: Ventilation and Alarm Settings

  Scenario: Adjust PEEP from 0-20 cmH2O with increments of 1
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the user adjusts PEEP to 5 cmH2O
    Then the PEEP value is displayed as 5 cmH2O
    And the PEEP value is stored in the system

  Scenario: Render parameters and alarms readable at a distance of 1m
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the user views the page from a distance of 1m
    Then the parameters and alarms are readable

  Scenario: Adjust RR from 5-30 bpm with increments of 1
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the user adjusts RR to 10 bpm
    Then the RR value is displayed as 10 bpm
    And the RR value is stored in the system

  Scenario: Adjust IER from 1:1 to 1:4 (Inhale to exhale)
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the user adjusts IER to 1:2
    Then the IER value is displayed as 1:2
    And the IER value is stored in the system

  Scenario: Confirm all ventilation and alarm setting changes
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the user adjusts PEEP to 5 cmH2O and confirms the change
    Then the PEEP value is displayed as 5 cmH2O
    And the PEEP value is stored in the system

  Scenario: Adjust O2 infusion (FiO2) in supplied air from 0.21 to as close to 1 as possible with a minimum of 0.96, adjustable in increments of 0.1
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the user adjusts FiO2 to 0.95
    Then the FiO2 value is displayed as 0.95
    And the FiO2 value is stored in the system

  Scenario: Adjust HFNC flow rate from 0 to 60 L/min in increments of 5 L/min
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the user adjusts HFNC flow rate to 30 L/min
    Then the HFNC flow rate value is displayed as 30 L/min
    And the HFNC flow rate value is stored in the system

  Scenario: Compute amount of leakage based on controller actuation and sensor readings
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the controller actuates and sensor readings are available
    Then the amount of leakage is computed and displayed

  Scenario Outline: PEEP adjustment with edge and invalid values
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the user adjusts PEEP to <PEEP>
    Then the PEEP value is displayed as <PEEP>
    And the PEEP value is stored in the system
    Examples:
      | PEEP  |
      | 0     |
      | 20    |
      | -1    |
      | 21    |

  Scenario Outline: RR adjustment with edge and invalid values
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the user adjusts RR to <RR>
    Then the RR value is displayed as <RR>
    And the RR value is stored in the system
    Examples:
      | RR  |
      | 5   |
      | 30  |
      | -1  |
      | 31  |

  Scenario Outline: IER adjustment with edge and invalid values
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the user adjusts IER to <IER>
    Then the IER value is displayed as <IER>
    And the IER value is stored in the system
    Examples:
      | IER  |
      | 1:1 |
      | 1:4 |
      | 1:-1|
      | 1:5 |

  Scenario Outline: FiO2 adjustment with edge and invalid values
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the user adjusts FiO2 to <FiO2>
    Then the FiO2 value is displayed as <FiO2>
    And the FiO2 value is stored in the system
    Examples:
      | FiO2 |
      | 0.21|
      | 1    |
      | -0.1 |
      | 1.1  |

  Scenario Outline: HFNC flow rate adjustment with edge and invalid values
    Given the user is on the ventilation settings page
    When the user adjusts HFNC flow rate to <HFNC>
    Then the HFNC flow rate value is displayed as <HFNC>
    And the HFNC flow rate value is stored in the system
    Examples:
      | HFNC |
      | 0    |
      | 60   |
      | -5   |
      | 65   |
```
